target: Prove that the uniformly random 8-regular graph G_{n,8} (n -> infinity) has chromatic number exactly 4 asymptotically almost surely, or isolate the exact failing dependency of the proposed route.

status_before.kpw: Kemkes-Perez-Gimenez-Wormald Theorem 1 (pinned review/colour7-parent-source-screen-v1/): at d = 8 the smallest k with d < 2(k-1)log(k-1) is k = 5, so chi(G_{n,8}) is a.a.s. 4 or 5; the exact-value clause needs d > 7 log 4 and does not apply.
status_before.acg: Ayre-Coja-Oghlan-Greenhill arXiv:1812.09691v4 Table 1: q = 4 has d_{q,smm} = 6 and d_q = 10, so d = 8 is undetermined there.
status_before.an_npg: Achlioptas-Naor display (12) and Nir-Perez-Gimenez arXiv:2109.13347v1 Theorem 1.2 reach only d < l_4 = (27/4) log 3 = 7.4156 (the latter for random lifts of loopless graphs). The d = 7 transfer is accepted in review/chi7-parent-verdict.md and stops below d = 8.
status_before.open_label: DERIVED-OPEN from KPW's {4,5} window and ACG Table 1; not an explicitly named open problem. A bounded worker search (2026-10-17 07:22-07:24 PDT, five queries) found no statement of chi(G_{n,8}) = 4; a miss is not novelty.

pilot_untrusted.route: Replace KPW's Lemma 5/(3.9)+(3.15) relaxation in the S_2 estimate by an exact-exponent pointwise weak-duality bound (Lemma A) with multipliers lambda_u = ln C + (7/8) ln m_u, giving U(M) = -10 ln 2 + 4 ln E(M), E(M) = sum over allowed cell pairs of (m_u m_v)^{7/8}; prove E(M) <= E(J) - kappa ||M - J||^2 with kappa = (441/128)(a^2 - 1/9), a = 7^{-(ln 3)/2}, through an inclusion-exclusion row reduction and complete-graph hypercontractivity (Diaconis-Saloff-Coste 1996 Theorem A.1 and Theorem 3.5(ii); condition ln 7 <= 2), with a second elementary proof of the row inequality. The route needs ln(d-1) <= 2 and fails at d = 9.

acceptance.proof: A frozen written proof PROOF_CHI8.r1.md that (1) states every imported theorem with exact hypotheses and verifies them at (k,d) = (4,8): KPW Sections 2-4 and Theorem 10, Wormald 1999 Theorem 4.1, Molloy-Reed; (2) proves Lemma A at finite n with every factorial bound, the polynomial factor and empty cells handled; (3) proves Theorem C with both row-inequality proofs, the hypercontractivity normalization quoted from the pinned primary source, and all constants verified exactly or with interval arithmetic; (4) contains an explicit audit row showing that KPW's Lemma 5, (3.7) and (3.9) enter only the S_2 estimate and Theorem 10's restriction, and that the S_1 asymptotics need only (H1) k^2-2k-d+2 = 2 > 0; (5) proves the small-subgraph-conditioning conditions at (4,8); (6) handles every residue n mod 4 (r = 1,2,3; l = 4r distinguished edges whose endpoints induce a perfect matching; exact conditional uniformity); (7) proves the lower bound chi >= 4 (Molloy-Reed: 3(2/3)^4 = 16/27 < 1).
acceptance.review: Parent constant replay; Codex CLI hostile review and Claude CLI complete review of the frozen file; parent delta review of any revision.
acceptance.refutation_of_route: An explicit doubly stochastic M (rigorously enclosed) violating the claimed U(M) <= U(J) - C_8||M-J||^2, or a KPW dependency that genuinely needs Lemma 5's form outside S_2. This would refute the route only, not the target.

controls: Reproduce the pilot's arb constants; show the same argument fails at d = 9 (ln 8 > 2) without claiming any d = 9 result; float sanity of U - Psi_8 on random doubly stochastic matrices is not evidence.
priority_kill_check: Bounded search for any statement of chi(G_{n,8}) = 4 (uniform model), for any improvement of the Achlioptas-Naor balanced-colouring maximization at k = 4 beyond (27/4) log 3 for random regular graphs, and for hypercontractivity/weak-duality treatments of the colouring second moment.
